data.name: KINGLING: An Adventure Through Realms
data.detailed_description:
Step into the chaotic cartoon world of Kingling, a 2.5D boss-driven action platformer bursting with personality. With fast, skill-based combat and unforgettable showdowns, every battle is a test of reflexes, timing, and determination.

Kingling is built around memorable, personality-packed boss fights. From haunted stages to chaotic carnival arenas, each battle introduces new mechanics, attack patterns, and escalating phases that test your reflexes and timing.

Experience a hand-crafted world inspired by vintage rubber-hose animation, brought to life with modern depth and dynamic camera movement.

Every stage feels like stepping into a new animated episode — bursting with exaggerated characters, expressive animation, and theatrical flair.

Battle your way through imaginative environments filled with danger and personality. Each level introduces a new setting, new mechanics, and a new larger-than-life adversary.

No two fights feel the same.

data.short_description: Kingling is a fast-paced 2.5D cartoon action platformer inspired by classic animation. Battle through wildly themed stages where every level builds toward a larger-than-life boss encounter. Master tight, skill-based combat and prove yourself in a world that looks charming — but fights back hard.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad recommended. SSD recommended for optimal performance.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad recommended. SSD recommended for optimal performance.
